newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower, July holds support.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower, July holds support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled weaker but off the lows as trade buying stymied early losses, trading sources said.
Speculative rolling of July positions pinched the July/October spread to 0.12 cent July premium on the close, from 0.14 cent on Monday.
The speculators triggered light sell stops early and pushed July below 11.37, where a double bottom had formed on the charts, to 11.32 cents.
While the trade absorbed a significant amount of the selling, market sources expect the speculators, who hold a heavy net long position, to continue to chip away at prices.
"The specs have no choice but to roll at current levels," a trader said.
Support was pegged from 11.20 to 11.00 cents basis July.
July closed 0.08 cent lower to 11.37 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.41 to 11.32 cents. October settled down 0.06 at 11.25, while the outer months went out 0.04 to 0.07 weaker.
Volume reached an estimated 24,223 lots, compared with Monday's official 17,318 lots, CSCE said.
Liquidation of the front month is expected to accelerate once July options expire on Friday.
Open interest in July remains high with just 14 trading days before expiry.
Open interest in July stood at 75,732 lots, down 2,686 lots as of early Monday. Second-position October gained 2,159 lots to 65,512 lots.
